title: Admission Criteria and Pre-Admission Assessment Validity (Assisted Living)
content:
The Admissions Office opens an Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement on the following criteria.

1. **Assessment.** An admission is opened only on a pre-admission care-point assessment by a Larkspur nurse, recorded with the admission. The admitted care level is the level whose care-point band, from its lowest to its highest score, contains that score.
2. **Age.** The resident must be at least the minimum resident age of the timing standards (55 years) on the planned move-in date, by the date of birth on the customer profile. The profile record is the basis, not a statement made on the call.
3. **Needs beyond assisted living.** A score above the highest score of the highest care level, or a wander or exit-seeking risk where such a risk is excluded from assisted living, means assisted living cannot meet the resident's needs and no admission is opened; the family is referred to memory care admissions.
4. **Rent.** The contracted monthly rent is the published rent of the apartment type on the admission date.
5. **Validity of the assessment at move-in.** Move-in may take place only within the pre-admission assessment validity period after the pre-admission assessment. The validity period is counted in calendar days from the assessment date, the assessment date being day 0, and move-in on the last day of the period is still valid; after it lapses a new pre-admission assessment is required before move-in. The assessment date is read from the recorded pre-admission assessment of that residency.
6. **Withdrawal before move-in.** An admission may be withdrawn before move-in only by the applicant's own signed withdrawal or that of a representative whose authority on the customer profile is a financial power of attorney, a durable power of attorney or guardianship. Nothing is charged for a withdrawn admission, because rent, care fees and the community fee begin only at move-in.

### Boundary cases for item 5 (hypothetical dates, validity period of 30 days)

| Pre-admission assessment | Move-in date | Day count | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 31 March | day 30 | Valid: last day of the period |
| 1 March | 1 April | day 31 | Lapsed: a new pre-admission assessment is required before move-in |
| 1 March | 1 March | day 0 | Valid |

### Points of judgement

- A caller who is a daughter without any recorded authority cannot sign the withdrawal; a representative recorded as guardian can.
- A hypothetical applicant born on 10 June 1971 is 55 on a planned move-in date of 10 June 2026 and meets the age criterion; on 9 June 2026 the applicant is 54 and does not.
